claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified as compliant on the basis of aggregate launch-readiness evidence, provided the model card discloses liability evidence summarization as an unresolved evaluation gap or unknown limitation rather than a passed area.
decision_criteria: If the certification artifact already includes explicit disclosure of the named-context evaluation gap and policy allows certification with disclosure alone, the verdict could improve.
If there is approved risk acceptance or a documented exception for launching before those evals are complete, the verdict could improve.
If liability evidence summarization eval results are produced and show acceptable performance, the main concern would be resolved.
Without disclosure evidence, exception evidence, or completed evals for the named deployment context, certification remains insufficiently supported.
evidence_requests: Provide the exact model-card text or certification artifact showing liability evidence summarization is disclosed as an unresolved evaluation gap or unknown limitation.
Provide the underlying release policy language or approval record showing whether certification with this unresolved named-context gap is permitted if disclosed.
Provide any approved risk-acceptance, launch exception, or sign-off covering the missing liability evidence summarization evals.
Provide the actual evaluation plan or deployment-context record confirming liability evidence summarization is a named launch context and that its evals are still pending.
specific_concerns: The record, as summarized, supports general launch readiness but also shows a named deployment context with missing evaluation coverage.
The actor recommends certification even though the policy text requires named-context evaluation gaps to be disclosed or resolved before clean certification.
No admissible evidence is provided that the final model card actually contains the required disclosure language.
No admissible evidence is provided of an approved risk acceptance covering the unresolved liability evidence summarization gap.
Evidence access is limited to the actor's summary, so the cited documents cannot be independently checked for scope, wording, or conditions.
unsupported_claims: That certification is fully supportable on the current record without first proving the required named-context disclosure is in the certification artifact.
That the unresolved liability evidence summarization gap is adequately handled merely by describing it as an unknown limitation, absent evidence that this disclosure was actually made and accepted.
Any implication that general support, latency, rollback, and aggregate readiness results are sufficient by themselves for certification of all named deployment contexts.
